description: This file defines an interface 'AsyncCommandClient' for sending asynchronous commands to devices within the Eclipse Hono client framework. It includes methods for sending commands with associated data, correlation IDs, reply IDs, content types, and optional properties, all returning Vert.x futures for asynchronous operation.

classes.name: AsyncCommandClient
classes.description: An interface for sending asynchronous request-response commands to devices, scoped to specific tenants and devices.

methods.name: sendAsyncCommand
methods.description: Sends an async command to a device without expecting an immediate response, returning a Future indicating the result. Overloaded to include optional contentType and properties.
